summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Dark Funnel Intent Detection app. 9/9 pytest backend tests passed. All required frontend data-testids present and interactions (high-intent filter, row expand for AI summary, simulate visit, manage accounts modal add-account) work end-to-end. Seed data verified: 200+ events, 20 target accounts, 46+ Claude-generated alerts.

issues: With current seed data every matched company has max_score >= 70, so toggling 'High intent only' visibly filters nothing. Not a bug — expected given seed distribution — but a reviewer might want more low-score matched companies in seed to make the filter visually meaningful.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'); consider migrating to lifespan handlers for FastAPI 0.100+ forward-compat.

regenerate_alerts endpoint iterates all high-intent events synchronously with await summarize_session per event; for 50+ events with ~2s Claude latency this endpoint can exceed 100s. Consider background task / streaming response or explicit long-timeout doc.
CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router — works in FastAPI but conventionally middleware is added before routers.
Frontend uses relative /api URLs (works because same origin) — good; no REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL usage needed here since it is a static HTML served by backend origin.
No pagination on /api/events or /api/alerts beyond a limit param; fine for demo scale.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data (200 events, 20 accounts, 46 alerts). Test created and cleaned up 1 TEST_PW_Corp account and 2 synthetic events during runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers stats, accounts CRUD (+409 dup), event ingest (matched high-intent + residential no-match), events filter, matched-visits aggregation & sort, alerts list, and regenerate idempotency. Frontend testids verified: dashboard-root, stat-* (total/matched/high/alerts/accounts), visits-table, alerts-list, filter-high-intent, visits-search, simulate-visit-btn, regen-alerts-btn, manage-accounts-btn, accounts-modal, close-accounts-modal, accounts-table, account-row-{id}, delete-account-{id}, new-account-form, new-acc-name, new-acc-domain, new-acc-industry, new-acc-owner, new-acc-tier, add-account-btn, visit-row-{id}, score-{id}, summary-row-{id}, alert-item-{id}. Test data prefix is 'TEST_' / 'pwtest-'. To re-seed DB run: cd /app/backend && python seed_data.py.
